name: New Zealand's Cyber Security Strategy 2015
owner: Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (New Zealand)
description: New Zealand's Cyber Security Strategy 2015 (published December 10, 2015). National cyber security strategy of New Zealand enabling New Zealanders to thrive online across cyber-resilient individuals/businesses, cyber-capable workforce, resilient critical infrastructure, and active international partnerships.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (New Zealand) (dpmc.govt.nz) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (New Zealand) (dpmc.govt.nz).
